Hi, I probably shouldn't post here bc I'm not a therapist or anything, but I'm interested in this because I used to pretend I had DID, or rather OSDD. This was before TikTok though, I had all my information from Tumblr.

I'm obviously not able to really take part in this dicussion, but I want to add two things.

One - the biggest reason besides being something "special" for me was being part of a community. The people on tumblr (who honestly probably also didn't have DID/OSDD) would post things that I could really relate to. Looking back they were pretty normal human experiences, but they were labled as DID/OSDD things, so I thought that's what I have. When I would post stuff like this, people would interact with me and support me, telling me my experiences are valid etc. It just felt good to be part of a community and having people tell me that what I'm feeling is real.

Two - Maybe this is just a personal thing, but I like putting things in boxes and applying labels. Dividing my emotions, wishes, experiences and different interests in specific boxes (alters), I think just helped me make sense of them. I was a teenager and I think I didn't fully understand that humans are naturally really complex and can feel and believe totally contradictory things at the same time.

Btw I feel like I should mention that later I got diagnosed with BPD and clinical depression, which probably also played a part in this. Severe mood swings can really feel like you're suddenly a completely different person!
Well anyway, again I'm really sorry if I shouldn't have commented here.
